name: Wannegan
role: Hunter riding with Luffsey when Luffsey was killed
bio: Wannegan (also Wonegan) was riding with Riley Luffsey and O'Donald when the Marquis de Morès's party met them and Luffsey was killed; the Cow Boy called him and Luffsey quiet, peaceable hunters. At the September 1885 trial, the prosecution said the three were riding home when concealed parties fired on them, and a witness named Wadsworth was asked about having gone with Wannegan to visit de Morès in jail.
